title: Maximum Increasing Element Difference
description: Choose indices `i < j` with `nums[i] < nums[j]`. Return the largest possible difference `nums[j] - nums[i]`, or -1 if no such pair exists. Input: `nums`. Output: the maximum increasing difference or -1.
hints: Keep a running total or frequency count rather than recomputing over all prefixes.
Test repeated values, zeros, and minimum-size inputs.
